up: Retrieve activity data for the human target CHEMBL335 (Tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 1). Join activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter for: 1) Target CHEMBL ID = 'CHEMBL335' (from target_dictionary), 2) Target organism is Homo sapiens (tax_id = 9606), 3) Standard type is 'IC50', 4) Standard relation is '=', 5) pChEMBL value is not null. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the result to the first 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, ac.standard_type, ac.pchembl_value FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ac.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON ac.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL335' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND ac.standard_type = 'IC50' AND ac.standard_relation = '=' AND ac.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
